description: Casuya edge cache rules for Cloudflare. Import via dashboard (Caching > Cache Rules) or push through the Cloudflare API. The backend already emits correct Cache-Control headers (see backend/api/lessons.py and docker/nginx/default.conf); these rules harden edge caching and guarantee auth/api paths are never cached.

rules.description: Cache vendored static libs (KaTeX, etc.) for 1 year
Cache immutable lesson content served via the API (backend sets stale-while-revalidate)
Never cache auth, dynamic API, or health checks
Never cache HTML pages (auth + role dispatch must stay dynamic)

notes: Follow-up (not done here): migrate /storage/ uploads to Cloudflare R2 and serve them from a r2.dev / custom domain so they are cached at the edge without hitting the origin.
Brotli compression is handled by Cloudflare's edge; nginx only sends gzip. No nginx brotli module is enabled to avoid breaking the container image.
